protocol.selection_rule: native non-invalid only; capture, route quality, retention, observed opening proximity, stable ID; if none admitted repeat baseline as rejection
protocol.confirmation_rule: Three newly executed nominal repeats of selected posture; not robust, perturbed or independent layout evaluation
protocol.baseline_rule: Exactly one gap=0/tilt=0 request per source posture; fresh execution compared descriptively with original short miss
protocol.requested_gap_definition: ball bottom above board CENTRE plane, not gap to tilted top surface
protocol.invalid_request_policy: No clipping/projection/substitution; geometry rejections remain in requested denominators

scoring.arm_control: Prescribed joint endpoints reset before each native step; no learned grasp/transit/actuator dynamics
scoring.scorer: Unchanged board rebound + whole sphere entry + continuous1s retention; external assistance disqualifies route; bucket rim assistance counts

protocol.scope: Validation-selected short-miss development search. Fixed bucket and board XYZ; only board tilt and vertical ball-bottom gap above board CENTRE plane vary. Prescribed joint endpoints and spawned free-flight ball, not grasp/release or compliant arm control. No final TEST or benchmark replacement.

limitations: Validation-selected short-miss development search. Fixed bucket and board XYZ; only board tilt and vertical ball-bottom gap above board CENTRE plane vary. Prescribed joint endpoints and spawned free-flight ball, not grasp/release or compliant arm control. No final TEST or benchmark replacement.
Only 2 observed-short validation bucket positions and 3 source postures are diagnosed; no all-table coverage.
Three repeated nominal executions establish local repeatability only; no perturbation robustness or generalization claim.
Frozen benchmark policies, original results, calibration/scoring and final TEST remain unchanged.
